what: A and B in Play on A's shared world (B joined, ~3 tiles apart): A switches to the 16-bit look and looks at Bea's name plate

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const R = await import('/engine/remoteRoster.ts'); const P = await import('/engine/playerProbe.ts'); const me = P.samplePlayer(); return JSON.stringify({ look: S.useEngineStore.getState().landLook, me: { x: +me.x.toFixed(2), z: +me.z.toFixed(2) }, others: R.sampleRemotePlayers(performance.now()).map(p => ({ name: p.name, x: +p.x.toFixed(2), z: +p.z.toFixed(2) })) }) })()
